content.response_text:
**Claim TM‑2026‑0061 – Status Summary (as of 23 Sept 2026)** | Item | Detail | |------|--------| | **Reference** | TM‑2026‑0061 | | **Tenant / Policy** | Thornfield Mutual – Policy # TM‑CP‑118460 | | **Policyholder** | Halstead Joinery Limited | | **Class of Claim** | Commercial property – fire | | **Incident Date** | 2 April 2026 | | **Status** | **Open** (large‑loss claim, escalated on notification) | | **Reserve (GBP)** | £214,000 | | **Payments to Date** | £60,000 (partial claim settlement) | | **Current Handling Note** (from claim record) | • Large loss, escalated on the day of notification.
• Fire in the dust‑extraction plant; cause established as a failed bearing.
• Hot‑work permit records requested and produced.
• Business‑interruption claim running alongside.
• Re‑insurance team notified on 3 April 2026. | | **Key Parties** | • Claims Handler – Large Loss Unit (LLU)
• Re‑insurance carrier (identified on 3 Apr 2026) | | **Next‑Step Priorities** | 1. **Finalise Business‑Interruption (BI) claim** – gather income‑loss evidence, reconcile claimant’s invoices, and submit to the re‑insurance underwriter.
2. **Complete Fire‑Damage Assessment** – coordinate on‑site inspection, obtain updated condition reports, and confirm any additional loss reserves.
3. **Reserve Utilisation Review** – schedule a reserve‑utilisation meeting with the LLU manager to discuss payout schedule and any remaining balance.
4. **Re‑insurance Follow‑Up** – verify that the re‑insurance team has received all supporting documentation and confirm the settlement timeline.
5. **Documentation & Reporting** – prepare a formal claim status report (including a concise timeline, key findings, and remaining actions) to be filed in the case file. | **Why these steps?** - The claim remains **open** because the business‑interruption loss and the full fire‑damage reserve have not yet been finalised. - Escalation to the Large Loss Unit and re‑insurance notification indicates that the claim is being treated as a high‑value case; both parties need to receive the required supporting evidence to close the gap between the reserve and paid amount. - Timely completion of the BI claim will prevent future disputes and ensure the policyholder receives the full interruption benefit, which is a prerequisite for releasing the remaining reserve balance. **Immediate Actions (next 7‑14 days)** 1. **Obtain BI claim documentation** – invoice reconciliations, lost‑revenue calculations, and any supporting contracts from Halstead Joinery. 2. **Arrange on‑site fire‑damage inspection** – schedule a detailed survey to assess any additional loss beyond the current reserve of £214k. 3. **Submit missing re‑insurance artefacts** – forward all hot‑work permit records, cause‑analysis reports, and the re‑insurance settlement notice to the re‑insurance team for their review. 4. **Reserve utilisation meeting** – convene a brief review meeting with the LLU manager to confirm that any additional payments will be accounted for and that the remaining reserve balance is sufficient for the projected loss. Once these items are completed, the claim can be progressed toward **final settlement** and closure.
